text.vi: Endpoint SageMaker gần thời gian thực chỉ nhận request vào buổi sáng và chiều; phần lớn thời gian nhàn rỗi. Công ty chấp nhận latency vài phút nhưng không vài giờ. Cách tối ưu chi phí tốt nhất trong các lựa chọn?
text.en: An ML engineer deployed an ML model in production that uses a near real-time Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint. After deploying the near real-time endpoint for a few months, the ML engineer realized that use of the instance is less than expected. The endpoint receives inference requests during only the morning and afternoon. The ML engineer wants to optimize for cost. A few minutes in response latency is acceptable, but not hours. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

text.vi: Thêm Lambda function URL gọi endpoint hiện tại.
text.en: Provision an AWS Lambda function to be invoked through a Lambda function URL. Configure the Lambda function to send an inference request to the existing endpoint.

explanation.vi: Endpoint cũ vẫn chạy và tính phí; Lambda chỉ thêm tầng gọi.
explanation.en: The existing endpoint remains billable; Lambda merely adds a calling layer.

text.vi: Tạo endpoint serverless và bỏ endpoint hiện tại.
text.en: Provision a new serverless inference endpoint. Terminate the existing endpoint.

explanation.vi: Serverless giảm compute nhàn rỗi khi workload tương thích và chấp nhận cold start.
explanation.en: Serverless reduces idle compute when the workload fits and can tolerate cold starts.

text.vi: Bỏ endpoint và chuyển sang batch transform.
text.en: Terminate the existing endpoint and switch to batch transform.

explanation.vi: Batch không phù hợp thời gian phản hồi vài phút theo từng request như mô tả.
explanation.en: Batch does not fit the stated per-request response window.

text.vi: Bỏ endpoint và tự host model trên EC2.
text.en: Terminate the SageMaker AI endpoint and replace the endpoint with an Amazon EC2 instance. Deploy the model on the EC2 instance and redirect the inference requests to the model endpoint on the EC2 instance.

explanation.vi: EC2 thường trực vẫn có idle cost và thêm vận hành.
explanation.en: A persistent EC2 host retains idle cost and adds operations.

text.vi: Công ty dùng Bedrock cần model nhỏ, nhanh, tiết kiệm hơn mà đạt chất lượng gần model lớn tiên tiến trong một use case cụ thể. Cách tùy biến nào phù hợp?
text.en: A company wants to deploy a generative AI (GenAI) application by using Amazon Bedrock. The company must customize a model for a specific use case. The company needs a smaller, faster, and more cost-effective model that can achieve accuracy comparable to a larger, more advanced model. Which Amazon Bedrock customization method will meet this requirement?

text.vi: Continued pre-training.
text.en: Continued pre-training

explanation.vi: Continued pre-training bổ sung kiến thức qua dữ liệu chưa gắn nhãn, không trực tiếp chuyển teacher lớn sang student nhỏ.
explanation.en: Continued pre-training helps a model understand domain-specific terminology by using unlabeled data. Continued pre-training does not transfer knowledge from a larger model to a smaller model for cost and latency optimization.

text.vi: Supervised fine-tuning.
text.en: Supervised fine-tuning

explanation.vi: SFT thích nghi bằng dữ liệu có nhãn nhưng không đặc tả mục tiêu teacher-student.
explanation.en: Supervised fine-tuning improves model performance by using labeled data. Supervised fine-tuning does not meet the requirement for a smaller, faster model that matches a larger model's accuracy.

text.vi: Model distillation.
text.en: Model distillation

explanation.vi: Distillation huấn luyện student nhỏ từ tín hiệu teacher để giữ chất lượng đủ tốt trong tác vụ.
explanation.en: Model distillation transfers knowledge from a larger, more capable teacher model to a smaller, faster, and more cost-effective student model. Amazon Bedrock automates this process by generating high-quality responses from the teacher model and using the responses to fine-tune the student model. Then, the smaller model can achieve comparable accuracy for specific use cases.

text.vi: Reinforcement fine-tuning.
text.en: Reinforcement fine-tuning

explanation.vi: Reinforcement fine-tuning tối ưu theo tín hiệu thưởng, không phải cơ chế nén teacher-student được hỏi.
explanation.en: Reinforcement fine-tuning improves model alignment through feedback-based learning. Reinforcement fine-tuning does not specifically produce a smaller, faster model that achieves accuracy comparable to a larger model.

explanation.vi: Distillation huấn luyện student nhỏ từ tín hiệu teacher để giữ chất lượng đủ tốt trong tác vụ.
explanation.en: Model distillation transfers knowledge from a larger, more capable teacher model to a smaller, faster, and more cost-effective student model. Amazon Bedrock automates this process by generating high-quality responses from the teacher model and using the responses to fine-tune the student model. Then, the smaller model can achieve comparable accuracy for specific use cases.

text.en: An AI engineer deploys a generative AI (GenAI) chat-based assistant by using Amazon Bedrock. After deployment, the AI engineer notices that the model occasionally generates responses that do not relate to the provided source documents. Then, the assistant presents factually incorrect information to users. The AI engineer creates an Amazon Bedrock guardrail. The AI engineer must configure the guardrail to detect and prevent this issue. Which guardrail configuration will meet these requirements?

explanation.vi: Grounding so phản hồi với nguồn và query để phát hiện thông tin không được hỗ trợ.
explanation.en: Contextual grounding checks detect hallucinations in model responses. Contextual grounding checks verify if the responses are factually grounded in the source documents and if the responses are relevant to a user's query. Contextual grounding checks are especially useful for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) applications where responses should be based on retrieved documents. Contextual grounding checks can block or flag responses that deviate from the source documents.

The pipeline must deliver the transformed features to an Amazon S3 feature store for model training. Additionally, the pipeline must deliver the transformed features to an Amazon OpenSearch Service index for real-time inference. The pipeline must handle variable traffic volumes and support exactly-once processing semantics. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

text.vi: Model Canvas phân tích sentiment dự đoán positive/negative từ review sản phẩm. Dữ liệu lệch mạnh về review positive. Theo ý định bộ QA, nên xem metric nào thay vì dựa vào accuracy?
text.en: A data scientist is using a prebuilt ML model in Amazon SageMaker Canvas to conduct sentiment analysis. The model predicts either positive or negative sentiment based on product review text data. The dataset is heavily imbalanced in favor of positive reviews. Which prediction metric should the data scientist use to evaluate the model?

text.vi: Accuracy.
text.en: Accuracy

explanation.vi: Accuracy có thể rất cao chỉ bằng cách dự đoán lớp đa số.
explanation.en: Accuracy measures the proportion of correct predictions over all predictions, measuring how often the model makes correct predictions overall. For an imbalanced dataset that is skewed in favor of positive reviews, accuracy is not an appropriate metric. The model could predict most reviews as positive and achieve high accuracy.

text.vi: RMSE.
text.en: Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE)

explanation.vi: RMSE là metric regression, không phù hợp trực tiếp nhãn sentiment.
explanation.en: RMSE is a numeric prediction metric. RMSE measures the difference between the model prediction and the actual observed values, averaged over all values that are used in the prediction. The model in this scenario is a classification model, not a regression model. Therefore, RMSE would not be an appropriate metric for evaluation.

text.vi: Recall.
text.en: Recall

explanation.vi: Recall đo tỷ lệ bắt được lớp mục tiêu; cần chỉ rõ lớp mục tiêu khi phân tích.
explanation.en: Recall measures the proportion of correct positive predictions over all actual positive values. All actual positive values include both reviews that are correctly predicted as positive (true positive) and reviews that are incorrectly predicted as negative but are actually positive (false negative). To maximize recall means to minimize the false negatives.

text.vi: Precision.
text.en: Precision

explanation.vi: Precision cũng hữu ích với mất cân bằng, nhưng đo độ đáng tin của dự đoán positive thay vì độ bao phủ.
explanation.en: Precision measures the proportion of correct positive predictions over all positive predictions. Correct positive predictions include all the reviews that are predicted as positive sentiment that are actually positive (true positive). All positive predictions include both true positives and reviews that are incorrectly predicted as positive but are actually negative (false positive). To maximize precision means to minimize false positives or cases where the model misclassifies a negative review as positive. Therefore, this solution does not meet the requirements.

text.vi: Công ty dịch vụ dược fine-tune FM cho assistant trả lời tương tác thuốc và hướng dẫn liều dùng. Kỹ sư cần kiểm chứng dữ liệu và chất lượng chuyên môn. Hai bước nào phù hợp? (Chọn HAI)
text.en: A pharmacy services company wants to build a generative AI (GenAI) application to assist pharmacists. The application must answer drug interaction questions and provide dosage guidance. An AI engineer must fine-tune a foundation model (FM) for the application. The AI engineer needs to validate the integrity of the AI training data to ensure that the FM produces accurate, clinically appropriate responses. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Select TWO)

text.vi: Dùng leaderboard chung của FM để xác nhận clinical accuracy.
text.en: Use leaderboard benchmarks for the selected FM to validate that the model meets the company's clinical accuracy requirements.

explanation.vi: Leaderboard chung không thay kiểm chứng theo chuyên môn và use case.
explanation.en: General leaderboards do not validate this specialized use case.

text.vi: Xây testing harness đánh giá FM với ground truth; catalog bằng Glue, query Athena và theo dõi clinical metrics.
text.en: Develop a testing harness that automatically evaluates the fine-tuned FM against the ground truth dataset. Use AWS Glue to catalog the dataset. Use Amazon Athena to query the data and track model performance across defined clinical metrics.

explanation.vi: Harness so với ground truth cung cấp kiểm tra lặp lại theo metric đã định nghĩa.
explanation.en: A test harness provides repeatable evaluation against defined ground truth and metrics.

text.vi: Deploy trước, lưu phản hồi bệnh nhân vào S3 rồi dùng làm golden data để retrain.
text.en: Deploy the fine-tuned model and store patients' feedback on Amazon S3. Query S3 data by using AWS Glue. Use Amazon Athena to track performance metrics to help create a golden prompt-response pair dataset to use for re-training.

explanation.vi: Phản hồi sau deployment không thay kiểm chứng dữ liệu chuyên gia trước phát hành.
explanation.en: Post-deployment feedback does not replace expert validation before release.

text.vi: Tạo golden dataset gồm prompt-response do dược sĩ curate, với phạm vi phản hồi chấp nhận được.
text.en: Create a golden dataset that contains prompt-response pairs that were curated by pharmacists with a range of acceptable responses.

explanation.vi: Chuyên gia xác định nguồn tham chiếu đáng tin và các đáp án hợp lệ.

text.en: Deploy an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agent with guardrails that validates query-response pairs through agent consensus before fine-tuning begins.

explanation.en: Agent agreement can share errors and does not replace experts or ground truth.

text.en: A company is continuously collecting data to help improve the company's online recommendation system. An ML engineer is using a built-in Amazon SageMaker AI ML model. The ML engineer trains the model on an ml.m5.xlarge instance as new customer data is collected. The model must be trained every week, but the training is not time sensitive. How can the ML engineer train the model in the MOST cost-effective manner?

text.vi: Đặt EnableManagedSpotTraining=True.
text.en: In the SageMaker AI training job, set EnableManagedSpotTraining to True.

explanation.vi: Managed Spot giảm chi phí compute cho training linh hoạt; nên có checkpoint.
explanation.en: Managed Spot reduces compute cost for flexible training; use checkpoints.

text.vi: Chạy container trên ECS Fargate theo lịch.

text.en: Run a distributed ML job on an ephemeral Amazon EMR cluster.

text.en: A company urgently wants to deploy a newly trained ML model to improve customer experience for an existing application that has a custom traffic pattern. An MLOps engineer must build a deployment pipeline to host the model on a persistent, scalable endpoint that provides consistently low latency. The MLOps engineer must identify the instance type to use to host the model. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

text.vi: Chọn cấu hình dựa vào utilization trong SageMaker Profiler.
text.en: Choose a configuration that is based on the model's compute resource utilization in Amazon SageMaker Profiler.

explanation.vi: Profiler phản ánh training/compute profiling, không thay load test traffic inference tùy chỉnh.
explanation.en: SageMaker Profiler is a feature that captures metrics about the compute resources that are provisioned for SageMaker AI training jobs. You can use SageMaker Profiler to review compute resource utilization for the timeline of the training job. SageMaker Profiler does not provide information about resources that you can use during inference.

text.vi: Chạy endpoint recommendation job bằng Inference Recommender.
text.en: Use Amazon SageMaker Inference Recommender to run an endpoint recommendation job.

explanation.vi: Advanced endpoint recommendation kiểm thử traffic pattern và cấu hình endpoint theo yêu cầu.
explanation.en: Inference Recommender automates load testing and tuning on multiple endpoint instance types and configurations. You can run an endpoint recommendation job to perform custom load tests by specifying instance types, traffic patterns, and production requirements for latency and throughput. The endpoint recommendation job outputs performance and cost data for the custom load test. You can use the endpoint recommendation job output to select the instance type that meets production performance requirements for the known traffic pattern. This solution does not require you to write custom code.

text.vi: Chạy inference recommendation job mặc định bằng Inference Recommender.
text.en: Use Amazon SageMaker Inference Recommender to run an inference recommendation job.

explanation.vi: Default recommendation phù hợp gợi ý ban đầu, không thay kiểm thử traffic tùy chỉnh như advanced job.
explanation.en: Inference Recommender automates load testing and tuning for multiple instance types and configurations. Inference recommenders lists prospective instances for your model based on benchmarks of similar models. You can choose from these prospective instances without further load testing. An inference recommender job can inform endpoint configurations without the overhead of custom code. However, this solution does not address the custom traffic pattern.

text.vi: Tự dựng pipeline load test, cấp endpoint rồi so số liệu CloudWatch.
text.en: Deploy a load testing pipeline to provision endpoints and compare performance data in Amazon CloudWatch.

explanation.vi: Tự dựng có thể được nhưng tăng vận hành so với Inference Recommender.
explanation.en: CloudWatch captures metrics from your AWS resources and applications. You can develop and deploy custom code to perform load testing of various SageMaker AI endpoint configurations. You can use the metrics that SageMaker AI automatically captures in CloudWatch to inform endpoint configurations. For example, the metrics can include the number of invocations, model latency, and invocation errors. However, this solution requires additional overhead to develop the custom load testing tool. A solution that uses automated load testing in Inference Recommender would require less operational overhead.

text.vi: Data Wrangler chuẩn bị dữ liệu nhà ở 10 năm đã sắp theo ngày, gồm vị trí, diện tích và giá. Model cần tổng quát hóa tốt lên dữ liệu tương lai. Chọn split transform nào?
text.en: An ML engineer uses Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to prepare a dataset for training an ML model to predict housing prices. The dataset consists of housing data from the past 10 years sorted by date and includes features such as location, size, and price. The ML engineer wants to reduce prediction bias and ensure that the model generalizes well on future, unseen data. Which SageMaker Data Wrangler split transform will meet this requirement?

text.vi: Ordered split.
text.en: Ordered split

explanation.vi: Giữ thứ tự thời gian để train từ quá khứ và đánh giá trên giai đoạn mới hơn.
explanation.en: SageMaker Data Wrangler transform ordered split maintains the order of the input data and performs a non-overlapping split among train, test, and validation, which is optional, at predefined ratios. When a timeseries dataset is sorted by date, as in this scenario, the ordered split prevents data leakage across splits by ensuring that data in the train split comes before data in the test split. This method helps reduce prediction bias and ensures the model generalizes well on future, unseen data.

text.vi: Split by key.
text.en: Split by key

explanation.vi: Group/key split hữu ích cho nhóm nhưng không trực tiếp bảo toàn thời gian đã yêu cầu.
explanation.en: SageMaker Data Wrangler transform split by key ensures that data with the same keys do not occur in more than one split. This method is often used with id columns, so that the same id does not appear in both training and test splits. In this scenario, performing a split by key would introduce data leakage because the training data would contain samples that occurred later than some samples in the test data. This solution results in the test performance overstating the actual performance of the model and the model failing to generalize well on future, unseen data.

text.vi: Randomized split.
text.en: Randomized split

explanation.vi: Random split có thể trộn tương lai vào train khi đánh giá quá khứ.
explanation.en: SageMaker Data Wrangler transform randomized split splits data randomly among train, test, and validation (optional) at predefined ratios. This strategy is best when you want to shuffle the order of your input data. In this scenario, randomly splitting the data would introduce data leakage because the training data would contain samples that occurred later than some samples in the test data. This method results in the test performance overstating the actual performance of the model (prediction bias), and the model failing to generalize well on future, unseen data.

text.vi: Stratified split.
text.en: Stratified split

explanation.vi: Stratification giữ tỷ lệ nhóm/lớp, không bảo đảm thứ tự thời gian.
explanation.en: SageMaker Data Wrangler transform stratified split splits the data among train, test, and validation (optional) such that each split is similar with respect to a specified column's categories. This method ensures that all splits have the same proportion of each category as the input dataset. Stratified split is often used for classification problems to maintain a similar percentage of samples of each target class across splits. In this scenario, performing a stratified split would introduce data leakage because the training data would contain samples that occurred later than some samples in the test data. This solution results in the test performance overstating the actual performance of the model (prediction bias), and the model failing to generalize well on future, unseen data.

text.vi: Công ty dùng model SageMaker ở nhiều phòng ban, mỗi phòng có ngân sách AWS cố định hàng tháng. Họ muốn được báo khi chi tiêu dự kiến vượt ngân sách, với ít vận hành nhất.
text.en: A company builds and deploys ML models by using Amazon SageMaker AI. The models are used across multiple departments. The company allocates a monthly budget that each department can spend on AWS services. The company wants to ensure that each department knows when the department's monthly spend is likely to exceed the allocated budget. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

text.vi: Tạo fixed budget, lọc theo cost allocation tag tự định nghĩa của phòng ban, cảnh báo forecast monthly spend.
text.en: Create a budget in AWS Budgets with a fixed method. Specify a filter based on user-defined cost allocation tags that are associated with each department. Configure the budget to trigger an alert and notify the department based on the forecasted monthly spend.

explanation.vi: Fixed budget theo tag Department và forecast alert khớp trực tiếp yêu cầu.
explanation.en: You can use AWS Budgets to track and take actions based on AWS spend. You can use a fixed method for AWS Budgets to define a static budget every month. You can use user-defined cost allocation tags to monitor costs based on tags that you create, such as department ID or project ID. You can use AWS Budgets to establish filters based on tags and to trigger alerts. By configuring an alert based on the forecasted monthly spend, you can anticipate the likelihood of your monthly spend exceeding a defined threshold.

text.vi: Tạo auto-adjusting budget, lọc theo AWS-generated tag và gửi báo cáo hàng ngày.
text.en: Create a budget in AWS Budgets with an auto-adjusting method. Specify a filter based on AWS generated cost allocation tags that are associated with each department. Create budget reports for each department and configure AWS Budgets to deliver daily reports.

explanation.vi: Auto-adjusting thay đổi ngân sách, daily report không phải cảnh báo dự kiến vượt ngưỡng cố định.
explanation.en: You can use AWS Budgets to track and take actions based on AWS spend. However, the auto-adjusting method sets a dynamic budget based on previous spend instead of a fixed threshold. AWS generated cost allocation tags do not incorporate business logic, such as department ID or project ID. A solution that requires the departments to analyze daily reports requires additional operational overhead.

text.vi: Tạo Cost Explorer report theo tag để mỗi phòng tự xem và dự đoán.
text.en: Create a cost report for each department by using AWS Cost Explorer. Filter the cost report based on user-defined cost allocation tags that are associated with each department. Grant each department access to its own Cost Explorer report to review and predict when each department will exceed its own budget.

explanation.vi: Đòi hỏi tự đọc và dự đoán, không đáp ứng thông báo tự động ít vận hành.
explanation.en: You can use Cost Explorer to view and analyze AWS costs and usage. You can create custom cost reports based on user-defined cost allocation tags. This solution requires the departments to access the Cost Explorer console. Therefore, this solution requires additional operational overhead.

text.en: A company uses Amazon SageMaker AI to develop an ML model. The company needs to receive a notification if a significant drift in model quality occurs. Which combination of actions will meet this requirement? (Select TWO)

text.vi: Tạo CloudWatch alarm gửi SNS khi metric vượt ngưỡng.
text.en: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that notifies an Amazon SNS topic when the model metrics exceed a threshold.

explanation.vi: Alarm nối metric với kênh thông báo SNS.
explanation.en: CloudWatch is a monitoring service that you can use to monitor AWS resources and applications. You can use CloudWatch metrics to create an alarm when a specific metric exceeds a threshold that you specify. For every state that a CloudWatch alarm can take, you can configure the alarm to send a message to an SNS topic.

text.vi: Thêm bước Data Wrangler gửi thông báo khi model metric vượt ngưỡng.

explanation.vi: Data Wrangler là chuẩn bị dữ liệu, không thay cơ chế monitoring alarm production.
explanation.en: You can use SageMaker Data Wrangler to import, prepare, and analyze data for ML tasks. You can use SageMaker Data Wrangler to streamline data preprocessing and feature engineering tasks with minimal coding. You cannot use SageMaker Data Wrangler for model monitoring or to send a notification based on metrics.

text.vi: Bật endpoint data capture và xuất model quality metrics tới CloudWatch.
text.en: Enable data capture on the SageMaker AI endpoint and publish model quality metrics to Amazon CloudWatch.

explanation.vi: Capture cùng Model Monitor và ground truth cung cấp metric chất lượng cần thiết.
explanation.en: You can enable data capture on a SageMaker AI endpoint to collect inference input and output data. By evaluating captured predictions against ground truth labels, you can calculate model quality metrics and publish them to CloudWatch. Publishing metrics to CloudWatch enables monitoring for model quality drift and supports integration with CloudWatch alarms for automated notifications when metric thresholds are exceeded.

text.vi: Dùng Data Wrangler kiểm tra định kỳ model metric cho feature drift.
text.en: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to periodically check model metrics for feature drift.

explanation.vi: Feature drift và model quality khác nhau; Data Wrangler không phải giải pháp giám sát ở đây.

text.vi: Online store, in-memory tier.
text.en: Enable the online store for the feature group. Use the in-memory tier storage type.

explanation.vi: In-memory online tối ưu lookup nhanh không được yêu cầu.
explanation.en: In-memory online storage optimizes unneeded low-latency lookups.

text.vi: Offline store, Apache Iceberg table format.
text.en: Enable the offline store for the feature group. Use the Apache Iceberg table format.

explanation.vi: Offline phù hợp lịch sử; Iceberg được khuyến nghị cho bảng analytics rất lớn và compaction.
explanation.en: Offline storage fits history; Iceberg is recommended for very large analytical tables and compaction.

text.vi: Offline store, AWS Glue table format.
text.en: Enable the offline store for the feature group. Use the AWS Glue table format.

explanation.vi: Glue offline cũng lưu lịch sử, nhưng Iceberg phù hợp hơn quy mô analytics được nhấn mạnh.
explanation.en: Glue offline storage also retains history, but Iceberg better matches the emphasized analytical scale.

explanation.en: Standard online storage is not the choice for full batch history.

text.vi: Model risk dùng SageMaker Processing và Training. Kỹ sư cần tự động retrain hàng tháng bằng dữ liệu mới rồi redeploy endpoint, và cho đội khác tái sử dụng pipeline CI/CD qua nhiều tài khoản. Cách ít vận hành nhất?
text.en: An ML engineer created a risk prediction model for a company. The ML engineer used Amazon SageMaker AI processing jobs for data preprocessing and training jobs to train the ML model. The ML engineer wants to set up an automated workflow to re-train the model monthly by using newly collected customer data. Then, the workflow will redeploy the model to a SageMaker AI endpoint. Other teams in the company must be able to deploy the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD)-enabled ML pipeline across accounts. Which solution to orchestrate the ML pipeline will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

text.vi: SageMaker Pipelines kết hợp SageMaker Projects để tái sử dụng.
text.en: Build a pipeline by using SageMaker Pipelines. Integrate the pipeline with SageMaker AI projects for reusability.

explanation.vi: Pipelines tích hợp các bước ML; Projects hỗ trợ mẫu CI/CD tái sử dụng.
explanation.en: SageMaker Pipelines provides an integrated SageMaker AI mechanism to orchestrate ML workflows. SageMaker AI projects provide standardization and templating of CI/CD pipelines that build and maintain the ML pipelines. In this solution, all components in the ML pipeline are built-in SageMaker AI components. Therefore, this is the most suitable solution to integrate into a SageMaker AI pipeline. You can use SageMaker AI projects to create a template that describes the ML pipeline. Other teams can use SageMaker AI projects to deploy the solution with CI/CD pipelines into the teams' AWS accounts.

text.vi: Jenkins end-to-end pipeline và Terraform module.
text.en: Build an end-to-end pipeline by using Jenkins. Create a Terraform module for reusability.

explanation.vi: Cần tự vận hành Jenkins và tích hợp nhiều bước đã được quản lý.
explanation.en: Jenkins is an open source workflow automation solution. Jenkins is a CI/CD tool that requires additional coding and configurations to build ML pipelines. Terraform is a third-party infrastructure as code (IaC) solution that you can use for automation. However, you need to create the IaC template for Terraform.

text.vi: Step Functions workflow kết hợp CodePipeline.
text.en: Build a workflow by using AWS Step Functions. Integrate the workflow with AWS CodePipeline for reusability.

explanation.vi: Có thể xây nhưng cần wiring thêm so với pipeline SageMaker chuyên dụng cho chuỗi công việc này.
explanation.en: Step Functions is a serverless workflow orchestration service. Step Functions integrates with SageMaker AI. However, Step Functions does not provide a mechanism to easily create a CI/CD pipeline that builds the state machine. The ML engineer used SageMaker AI to implement all components of the model. Therefore, if you use a SageMaker AI solution to implement the workflow, the SageMaker AI solution will require less operational effort. CodePipeline does not provide a suitable solution to deploy the step to multiple accounts.

text.vi: CodePipeline và CloudFormation template.
text.en: Build a pipeline by using AWS CodePipeline. Create an AWS CloudFormation template for reusability.

explanation.vi: CodePipeline quản lý CI/CD nhưng cần tự orchestration chi tiết các bước ML.
explanation.en: CodePipeline is a CI/CD service that you can use to build artifacts and deploy software. CodePipeline does not have built-in integration with SageMaker AI. You cannot use CodePipeline as an ML pipeline without extensive customization and coding.

text.vi: Model phân loại ảnh mới được kỳ vọng precision cao hơn. Công ty muốn test song song model cũ trên cùng dữ liệu mà không làm giảm precision khách hàng nhận được. Có thể chấp nhận một ít downtime. Chiến lược nào phù hợp?
text.en: A company deployed into production an ML model to use for image classification. The company developed a new version of the model with improved precision. The company wants to deploy the new model into production. The company must test the new model alongside the old model by using the same data. Precision cannot be compromised. Some downtime can be tolerated. Which deployment strategy will meet these requirements?

text.vi: Canary deployment.
text.en: Canary deployment

explanation.vi: Canary vẫn phục vụ một số người dùng bằng model chưa kiểm chứng.
explanation.en: Canary deployment would deploy the new model to a small group of users while other users continue to use the previous model. You can use canary deployment to test the new model alongside the old model. However, canary deployment does not perform inference on the same data. Additionally, this deployment strategy introduces risk because the system precision cannot be compromised.

text.vi: Shadow testing.
text.en: Shadow testing

explanation.vi: Shadow nhận bản sao request, trong khi model cũ tiếp tục trả kết quả cho người dùng.
explanation.en: Shadow testing makes the new version of the model available alongside the old version. The input data runs through both versions. This strategy performs inference on the same data. This strategy ensures that the new model works as expected while minimizing risks.

text.vi: A/B testing.
text.en: A/B testing

explanation.vi: A/B phục vụ các nhóm người dùng bằng model khác nhau và có thể tác động precision.
explanation.en: An A/B testing strategy deploys changes to a model by directing a defined portion of traffic to the new model and directing the remaining traffic to the old model. This deployment strategy does not perform inference on the same data. Additionally, this strategy introduces risk because the system precision cannot be compromised.

text.vi: Blue/green deployment.
text.en: Blue/green deployment

explanation.vi: Blue/green hỗ trợ chuyển fleet nhưng không tự thực hiện so song song cùng request mà bỏ kết quả model mới.
explanation.en: Blue/green deployment provides two identical production environments. After testing finishes on the green environment, traffic is directed from the green environment to the blue environment. A blue/green deployment strategy does not test the new model alongside the old model by using the same data.

text.vi: Data scientist xây model fraud trên SageMaker cần hiểu hiệu năng phát hiện giao dịch gian lận. Cách diễn giải metric nào đúng?
text.en: A data scientist at a financial company is building an ML model for fraud detection by using Amazon SageMaker AI. The data scientist needs to analyze evaluation metrics to understand how the model performs when detecting fraudulent transactions. How can the data scientist interpret evaluation metrics to analyze model performance?

text.vi: Dùng sensitivity để tránh gắn nhãn gian lận cho giao dịch hợp lệ.
text.en: Use model sensitivity to avoid detecting non-fraudulent transactions as fraudulent.

explanation.vi: Sensitivity đo bắt positive, không đo đúng negative để tránh false alarm.
explanation.en: Sensitivity measures positives detected, not correct negatives or false-alarm avoidance.

text.vi: Dùng accuracy làm metric phân tích chính khi các lớp mất cân bằng.
text.en: Use accuracy to analyze the model performance in the presence of imbalanced classes.

explanation.vi: Accuracy có thể che khả năng bỏ sót lớp fraud hiếm.
explanation.en: Accuracy can conceal failures on rare fraud cases.

text.vi: Dùng confusion matrix để phân tích sensitivity và specificity.
text.en: Use a confusion matrix to analyze the model's sensitivity and specificity.

explanation.vi: Confusion matrix cho TP/FP/FN/TN để tính sensitivity và specificity đúng vai trò.
explanation.en: A confusion matrix exposes TP/FP/FN/TN for interpreting sensitivity and specificity.

text.vi: Dùng specificity để đo khả năng phát hiện giao dịch gian lận.
text.en: Use model specificity to analyze the model's ability to detect fraudulent transactions.

explanation.vi: Nếu fraud là positive, specificity đo nhận đúng giao dịch không gian lận.
explanation.en: When fraud is positive, specificity measures correctly identified legitimate transactions.

text.vi: Assistant học tập dùng Bedrock Knowledge Bases với tài liệu theo chương, mỗi chương gồm định nghĩa, ví dụ và bài tập của một chủ đề. Phản hồi thiếu ngữ cảnh, không giải thích đầy đủ. Cách cải thiện nào phù hợp nhất?
text.en: An education technology company is building a learning AI assistant for students. The company uses Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases to implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) for the assistant. The knowledge base course materials are organized into chapters. Each chapter covers a single topic with definitions, examples, and practice problems. However, students find that the assistant's answers are incomplete and do not fully explain the topic. Which solution will improve the quality of the assistant's responses?

text.vi: Cấu hình hierarchical chunking, tạo lại index cần thiết và ingest lại tài liệu.
text.en: Configure hierarchical chunking in the knowledge base data source configuration. Delete the existing vector index. Re-ingest the course materials.

explanation.vi: Parent context kết hợp child retrieval có thể trả đủ phần định nghĩa và ví dụ liên quan.
explanation.en: The course materials have a parent-child structure. Each chapter contains definitions, examples, and practice problems for a specific topic. Hierarchical chunking creates linked parent and child chunks that preserve this structure. When retrieving a child chunk, the system replaces the child chunk with the parent chunk that contains the broader context and information. This solution resolves the issue of incomplete explanations that lack broader context.

text.vi: Đổi chunking sang semantic rồi chỉ sync data source hiện tại.
text.en: Update the knowledge base data source chunking strategy to semantic chunking. Sync the data source.

explanation.vi: Semantic có thể hỗ trợ nhưng không trực tiếp cung cấp parent context; đổi chunking cần chú ý ràng buộc data source.
explanation.en: Semantic chunking divides text based on semantic similarity rather than syntactic structure alone. Semantic chunking can improve chunk coherence. However, semantic chunking does not preserve the parent-child relationship between chapters and chapter content. Semantic chunking would not ensure that definitions, examples, and practice problems from the same topic link together during retrieval.

text.vi: Thêm reranking model rồi sync.
text.en: Configure a reranking model in the knowledge base. Sync the data source.

explanation.vi: Reranking chỉ sắp ứng viên, không tự thêm ngữ cảnh còn thiếu ngoài chunk.
explanation.en: A reranking model reorders retrieved chunks by relevance to the user query. A reranking model can improve precision. However, reranking does not add missing context to the retrieved chunks. Reranking will not resolve the issue in the scenario if the chunks themselves lack context.

text.vi: Đổi embedding sang vector nhiều chiều hơn rồi reindex.
text.en: Update the knowledge base embedding model to a model with a larger vector dimension. Reindex the course materials.

explanation.vi: Vector nhiều chiều không tự giải quyết ranh giới và độ đầy đủ của context.
explanation.en: You can increase the vector size of the embedding model to improve the semantic representation of each chunk. However, this solution does not change how the course materials are chunked. The issue is that retrieved chunks lack broader context. Therefore, the scenario describes a chunking strategy issue, not a dimensionality issue of the vector embedding.

editorialNote.en: Changing chunking may require a new data source/index and re-ingestion; do not assume an in-place edit plus sync is supported. Do not delete production indexes without migration/rollback planning.

text.vi: Assistant hỗ trợ khách hàng trên Bedrock đôi khi sinh hate speech và ngôn ngữ bạo lực. Cần tự động phát hiện/chặn dựa trên confidence trước khi trả người dùng. Cấu hình guardrail nào phù hợp?
text.en: An AI engineer is deploying a generative AI (GenAI) customer support chat-based application by using Amazon Bedrock. During testing, the AI engineer discovers that the model occasionally generates responses that contain hate speech and violent language. The AI engineer needs to automatically detect and block these harmful responses based on confidence levels before the responses reach end users. Which Amazon Bedrock Guardrails configuration will meet these requirements?

text.vi: Sensitive information filters với custom regex.
text.en: Enable sensitive information filters with custom regex patterns.

explanation.vi: Sensitive information filters nhắm PII, không phân loại harmful content theo ngữ cảnh.
explanation.en: Sensitive information filters are designed to block or mask personally identifiable information (PII). For example, PII includes email address, date of birth, and address. Sensitive information filters use entity-based detection and custom regex patterns for structured data patterns. You would not use sensitive information filters to detect harmful content categories.

text.vi: Content filters, strength high cho hate và violence.
text.en: Configure content filters and set the filter strength to high for hate and violence categories.

explanation.vi: Content filters đánh giá các nhóm gây hại và strength điều chỉnh mức chặn.
explanation.en: Content filters detect and filter harmful content across predefined categories, including hate and violence. Each response is classified with a confidence level for each category. The confidence levels include none, low, medium, and high. You can set the filter strength to high for hate and violence to block responses classified in these categories. This configuration provides the broadest protection against harmful content reaching end users.

text.vi: Word filters với danh sách từ hate/violence.
text.en: Create word filters by using a list of specific hateful and violent terms.

explanation.vi: Danh sách từ dễ bỏ sót cách diễn đạt lại và không tương đương bộ phân loại theo confidence.
explanation.en: Word filters block specific words or phrases based on exact matches. This configuration could catch some harmful terms. However, this configuration does not detect harmful content based on confidence levels. Word filters cannot identify hate speech or violent language that has variations, context-dependent phrasing, or terms that are not explicitly listed.

text.vi: Denied topics với vài câu mẫu hate/violence.
text.en: Define denied topics for hate speech and violence by using sample phrases.

explanation.vi: Denied topics kiểm soát chủ đề nghiệp vụ; content categories có sẵn khớp yêu cầu hơn.
explanation.en: You can use denied topics to define specific topics that should be blocked in user queries or model responses. Denied topics are designed to restrict conversations to specific subject areas. Denied topics are not designed to detect and classify harmful content based on confidence levels across predefined categories such as hate and violence. Hate speech and violent language can appear across many topics and would not be reliably caught by topic-level filtering alone.

text.en: A company uses Amazon Bedrock to improve enterprise search capabilities through a chat-based AI assistant interface. The assistant provides personalized responses to employee inquiries by using knowledge bases. The company wants to ensure that the assistant interactions are safe, appropriate, and align with the company's policy guidelines. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

text.vi: Thường xuyên cập nhật knowledge base với thông tin chính sách.
text.en: Regularly update the Amazon Bedrock knowledge base with the latest information that aligns with the company's policy guidelines.

explanation.vi: Nguồn đúng không tự lọc nội dung phát sinh hoặc chủ đề bị cấm.
explanation.en: Accurate source material does not itself filter generated content or disallowed topics.

text.vi: Dùng Bedrock Guardrails lọc hội thoại theo chủ đề và mức độ nhạy cảm.
text.en: Use Amazon Bedrock guardrails to monitor and filter assistant conversations based on predefined topics and sensitivity levels.

explanation.vi: Guardrails cung cấp lớp kiểm soát managed cho input/output theo chính sách.
explanation.en: Guardrails provide managed policy controls on inputs and outputs.

text.vi: Dùng Lambda proxy để bảo vệ token model sinh ra.
text.en: Use AWS Lambda as a proxy to secure tokens that are generated by the assistant.

explanation.vi: Proxy không tự đánh giá an toàn nội dung.
explanation.en: A proxy does not automatically evaluate content safety.

text.vi: Ghi log và theo dõi CloudWatch để phản ứng khi có nội dung không phù hợp.
text.en: Use comprehensive logging and monitoring of assistant interactions by using Amazon CloudWatch to detect and respond to inappropriate or unauthorized interactions.

explanation.vi: Giám sát sau sự kiện không thay bộ lọc trước khi trả phản hồi.
explanation.en: Post-event monitoring does not replace filtering before responses are delivered.

text.vi: Nhà bán lẻ muốn xử lý phản hồi về sản phẩm mới, nhận diện sản phẩm liên quan và sentiment positive/negative. Cách ít phát triển nhất?
text.en: A retail company wants to know what customers say about a recently launched product. An ML engineer needs to implement a solution to process customer feedback, identify the relevant product, and determine whether the feedback is positive or negative. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

text.vi: Dùng Lex NLU để trích product entity và sentiment.
text.en: Use Amazon Lex natural language understanding capabilities to classify feedback sentiment and extract the product entity.

explanation.vi: Lex hướng tới hội thoại/intent, không phải dịch vụ phân tích văn bản trực tiếp phù hợp nhất.
explanation.en: Lex focuses on conversational intents rather than this direct text-analysis task.

text.vi: Dùng JumpStart deploy model sentiment.
text.en: Use Amazon SageMaker JumpStart to select a pre-trained model and perform sentiment analysis from each piece of feedback.

explanation.vi: Phải chọn và host model khi Comprehend đã có API managed.
explanation.en: Model selection and hosting add work when managed Comprehend APIs fit.

text.vi: Dùng Comprehend pre-trained model trích insight từ phản hồi.
text.en: Use Amazon Comprehend with a pre-trained model to extract insights from each piece of feedback.

explanation.vi: Comprehend có entity và sentiment analysis không cần tự training/hosting.
explanation.en: Comprehend provides managed entity and sentiment analysis without custom hosting.

text.en: Use Amazon Textract to detect and extract the product entity and associated sentiment from each piece of feedback.

explanation.vi: Textract lấy chữ/cấu trúc tài liệu, không cung cấp sentiment như yêu cầu.
explanation.en: Textract extracts document text/structure rather than sentiment.

text.en: An AI engineer is building a personalized shopping assistant by using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. The assistant must remember customer preferences. For example, the assistant must remember favorite brands and sizes across different shopping sessions, even when the shopping sessions occur weeks apart. text.en: An ML engineer wants to create a text summarization model that is based on the Amazon SageMaker AI seq2seq algorithm. The ML model training data includes 1 TB of flat files. The ML engineer must convert the data to RecordIO-Protobuf format. Which solution will meet these requirements?

text.vi: Glue ETL ghi dữ liệu training dạng RecordIO-Protobuf vào S3.
text.en: Create an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job by using AWS Glue to write the training data in RecordIO-Protobuf format on Amazon S3.

explanation.vi: Glue không có output format RecordIO-Protobuf tích hợp sẵn như giả định của lựa chọn; code tùy chỉnh có thể thay đổi đánh giá.

text.vi: Công ty có search engine keyword tại chỗ cho tài liệu tiếng Anh, nay lưu tài liệu ở S3 và muốn MVP semantic search trên AWS với ít vận hành nhất. Chọn kiến trúc nào?
text.en: A company uses an on-premises textual search engine. The engine indexes proprietary documents in English and implements a keyword search. The company wants to migrate the solution to AWS. The company wants to improve the current search capabilities by adopting semantic search through large language models (LLMs). An AI engineer must build a minimum viable product (MVP) to demonstrate semantic search. Documents are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

text.vi: Neptune vector store với embedding từ Bedrock.
text.en: Use Amazon Neptune as a vector store. Use foundation models from Amazon Bedrock to provide the embeddings.

explanation.vi: Phải tự tích hợp indexing, retrieval và mô hình graph không cần thiết cho MVP.
explanation.en: Neptune is a graph database service. Neptune supports vector search capabilities, but is primarily designed for graph database use cases. Neptune would require additional configuration and maintenance overhead. Using Neptune would require you to manage the database infrastructure and implement custom logic for vector search.

text.vi: Bedrock Knowledge Bases quản lý embedding và vector store.
text.en: Use Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases to create a vector store and provide the embeddings.

explanation.vi: Knowledge Bases quản lý đường ingest/embed/retrieve nên giảm code vận hành MVP.
explanation.en: Amazon Bedrock is a generative AI platform that provides access to powerful foundation models. Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases give you the ability to create a solution that meets the requirements with minimal configuration. You can implement this solution by using boto3 APIs without the need to provision and configure services or manage data ingestion. In the background, Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases will automatically create an OpenSearch Serverless collection for the vector store. Additionally, Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases will use Amazon Bedrock foundation models for the embeddings and search.

text.vi: OpenSearch Serverless với embedding model deploy bằng JumpStart.
text.en: Use Amazon OpenSearch Serverless as a vector store. Use foundation models from Amazon SageMaker JumpStart to provide the embeddings.

explanation.vi: Cần tự ghép vector store và hosting model trong khi giải pháp KB đã có quản lý.
explanation.en: OpenSearch Serverless is the serverless configuration of Amazon OpenSearch Service. OpenSearch Service is an open source search engine that supports vector search. SageMaker JumpStart provides quick access to foundation models that you can deploy as real-time endpoints. To implement this solution, you would need to provision and manage additional services and perform data ingestion. For example, you would need to manage a SageMaker AI model endpoint. Therefore, this solution requires additional operational overhead.

text.vi: Aurora PostgreSQL pgvector với Bedrock embeddings.
text.en: Use Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL with the pgvector extension as a vector store. Use foundation models from Amazon Bedrock to provide the embeddings.

explanation.vi: Có thể dùng pgvector nhưng cần quản lý/integrate nhiều hơn KB managed.
explanation.en: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL with the pgvector extension supports vector similarity search. However, this solution requires you to provision and manage a database instance, configure the pgvector extension, create vector indexes, build a document ingestion pipeline, and write query logic. This approach requires more operational overhead.

text.vi: Công ty ô tô toàn cầu nhận scan đăng ký của hàng trăm nghìn xe và đã dùng Textract lấy chữ. Cần che VIN trước modeling với ít vận hành nhất. Giải pháp nào phù hợp?
text.en: A global automotive company is managing a fleet of hundreds of thousands of vehicles. For each new vehicle, the company receives a scan of the vehicle registration information card. The company uses Amazon Textract to extract the text from the scans. An ML engineer must redact the vehicle identification number (VIN) from the extracted text before being used for modeling. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

text.vi: Dùng Textract AnalyzeDocument nhận diện VIN rồi tự che.
text.en: Use Amazon Textract and the AnalyzeDocument operation to the detect the VIN. Replace the VIN characters in the text with masking characters.

explanation.vi: Textract OCR không tự cung cấp pipeline PII redaction theo yêu cầu.
explanation.en: Textract OCR does not itself provide the requested PII-redaction pipeline.

text.vi: Chạy Comprehend asynchronous PII redaction, cấu hình loại VIN.
text.en: Use Amazon Comprehend to run an asynchronous job to redact personally identifiable information (PII) entities. Set the redaction configuration to redact VINs from the text.

explanation.vi: Comprehend hỗ trợ VEHICLE_IDENTIFICATION_NUMBER trong PiiEntityTypes để redaction.
explanation.en: Comprehend supports VEHICLE_IDENTIFICATION_NUMBER in PiiEntityTypes for redaction.

text.vi: Viết Lambda regex nhận diện VIN và tự che.
text.en: Use AWS Lambda to implement application code with a regular expression to detect the VIN in the text. Replace the VIN characters in the text with masking characters.

explanation.vi: Regex có thể làm nhưng cần tự xây và kiểm thử khi loại PII đã hỗ trợ.
explanation.en: Regex can work but requires custom implementation and testing when the PII type is supported.

text.vi: Deploy model JumpStart nhận diện VIN rồi tự che.
text.en: Use Amazon SageMaker JumpStart to deploy an ML model that can detect the VIN. Replace the VIN characters in the text with masking characters.

explanation.vi: Hosting model riêng là thêm vận hành không cần thiết.
explanation.en: Hosting a separate model adds unnecessary operations.

hint.en: Identify the optimization target and the AWS capability addressing it directly.

explanation.en: Comprehend supports VEHICLE_IDENTIFICATION_NUMBER in PiiEntityTypes for redaction.

editorialNote.vi: Comprehend hỗ trợ VIN ở thời điểm kiểm tra; PII detection có giới hạn ngôn ngữ. Với đội xe toàn cầu, phải kiểm tra ngôn ngữ tài liệu.
editorialNote.en: Comprehend supports VIN at verification time; PII detection has language limits. For a global fleet, validate document languages.

text.vi: Công ty ảnh cá nhân hóa có hàng triệu vector ảnh cho Bedrock RAG assistant và recommendation. Một tập vector phổ biến cần tìm kiếm latency thấp, phần lớn lịch sử ít truy cập. Hai giải pháp lưu trữ nào kết hợp ít vận hành nhất? (Chọn HAI)
text.en: An ecommerce company specializes in personalized photography products. The company has millions of user-uploaded photos. The photos need to be represented as vector embeddings to support semantic similarity search. An AI engineer uses Amazon Bedrock to generate embeddings and to host a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) chat-based assistant. The assistant helps customers find matching photography products based on image content and descriptions. The AI engineer builds an AI-powered search and recommendation engine. A subset of the most popular product vectors must support low-latency search for the customer-facing recommendation engine. Most of the historical product vectors are infrequently accessed. The AI engineer must store the vector embeddings for both the assistant and the recommendation engine to access. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Select TWO)

text.vi: Dùng S3 Vectors integration với OpenSearch, export vector phổ biến sang OpenSearch Serverless collection.
text.en: Use the Amazon S3 Vectors integration with Amazon OpenSearch Service. Export popular product vectors from the S3 vector index to an OpenSearch Serverless collection.

explanation.vi: OpenSearch phục vụ tập hot cần latency thấp trong khi S3 Vectors giữ phần còn lại.
explanation.en: OpenSearch serves the low-latency hot subset while S3 Vectors retains the broader collection.

text.vi: Lưu vector trong DynamoDB với GSI để nearest-neighbor search.
text.en: Configure Amazon DynamoDB with a global secondary index (GSI) to store vector embeddings as attributes. Perform nearest neighbor searches on the vector data to provide low latency.

explanation.vi: GSI thông thường không thực hiện ANN vector search như mô tả.
explanation.en: A standard DynamoDB GSI does not implement the described ANN vector search.

text.vi: Lưu JSON vector ở S3 Express One Zone rồi dùng Athena similarity search.
text.en: Store vector embeddings in an Amazon S3 Express One Zone bucket as JSON files. Use Amazon Athena to perform similarity search queries across the dataset.

explanation.vi: Athena quét JSON không phải index similarity latency thấp được quản lý.
explanation.en: Athena scans over JSON are not a managed low-latency similarity index.

text.vi: Deploy Pinecone với auto scaling groups cho toàn bộ dữ liệu và cho Bedrock query trực tiếp.
text.en: Deploy a Pinecone vector embeddings database that uses auto scaling groups to handle the full vector dataset. Configure Amazon Bedrock to query the Pinecone vector database directly.

explanation.vi: Cách mô tả self-managed autoscaling Pinecone không phải tích hợp tiered managed phù hợp ở đây.
explanation.en: The described Pinecone autoscaling-group approach does not match the managed tiered integration here.

text.vi: Tạo S3 vector bucket/index làm vector store cho Bedrock KB, gắn metadata và content cho filtered query.
text.en: Create an Amazon S3 vector bucket with vector indexes. Use the bucket as the vector store for an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base to support the assistant. Attach metadata and content information to each vector for filtered queries.

explanation.vi: S3 Vectors cung cấp lưu trữ/index vector managed cho tập lớn và tích hợp KB.
explanation.en: S3 Vectors provides managed vector storage/indexing for the large collection and KB integration.

explanation.en: OpenSearch serves the low-latency hot subset while S3 Vectors retains the broader collection. S3 Vectors provides managed vector storage/indexing for the large collection and KB integration.

text.vi: Công ty chuyển ứng dụng ML dự đoán nhân viên nghỉ việc lên AWS và muốn giữ code Apache Spark hiện có. Giải pháp nào ít vận hành nhất theo ý định bộ QA?
text.en: A company wants to migrate an ML application to the AWS Cloud. The application predicts employee turnover. The company wants to continue using its current code implementation that is based on Apache Spark. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

text.vi: Chạy code trong Glue interactive session.
text.en: Run the code in an AWS Glue interactive session.

explanation.vi: Glue interactive chạy Spark được; phù hợp phát triển tương tác, vì vậy đề chưa đủ ràng buộc để loại tuyệt đối.
explanation.en: Glue interactive sessions can run Spark and suit interactive development, so the stem cannot absolutely rule them out.

text.vi: Chạy code trên EMR cluster.
text.en: Run the code in an Amazon EMR cluster.

explanation.vi: Cluster EMR thường đòi hỏi quản lý hơn job ML được quản lý theo lần chạy.
explanation.en: An EMR cluster generally needs more management than a per-job managed ML workflow.

text.vi: Chạy code trong SageMaker Spark Processing job.
text.en: Run the code in an Amazon SageMaker Spark Processing job.

explanation.vi: Spark Processing nhận code Spark, cấp tài nguyên và giải phóng sau job, phù hợp ứng dụng ML chạy theo job.

text.en: Run the code in Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler.

explanation.en: Data Wrangler is a data-preparation workflow, not a general unchanged Spark-application host.

text.vi: Kỹ sư chuẩn bị dữ liệu supervised fine-tuning FM Bedrock cho hỏi đáp theo miền. Hai hành động nào giảm bias trong tập training? (Chọn HAI)
text.en: An AI engineer prepares a dataset. The dataset will perform supervised fine-tuning of a foundation model (FM) on Amazon Bedrock for a domain-specific question-answering application. The AI engineer must ensure that the training dataset does not introduce bias into the fine-tuned model. Which combination of actions will mitigate bias in the training dataset? (Select TWO)

text.vi: Giảm số tham số trainable bằng PEFT.
text.en: Reduce the number of trainable parameters by using a parameter efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) technique.

explanation.vi: PEFT giảm tham số/chi phí, không sửa bias trong ví dụ.
explanation.en: PEFT reduces trainable parameters and cost, not bias in examples.

text.vi: Cấu hình Guardrails trong fine-tuning.
text.en: Configure Amazon Bedrock Guardrails during the fine-tuning process.

explanation.vi: Guardrails runtime không thay curation dữ liệu training.
explanation.en: Runtime guardrails do not replace training-data curation.

text.vi: Chạy automatic evaluation toxicity sau fine-tuning.
text.en: Run an Amazon Bedrock automatic model evaluation by using the toxicity metric after fine-tuning.

explanation.vi: Đánh giá sau training phát hiện vấn đề, không trực tiếp giảm bias dữ liệu đầu vào.
explanation.en: Post-training evaluation detects issues but does not directly fix input-data bias.

text.vi: Bảo đảm đại diện cân bằng giữa nhóm nhân khẩu học và chủ đề.
text.en: Ensure that the training dataset has balanced representation across different demographic groups and topics.

explanation.vi: Đại diện phù hợp giảm thiên lệch do nhóm/chủ đề bị thiếu.
explanation.en: Appropriate representation reduces bias from missing groups/topics.

text.vi: Rà soát và curate ví dụ để loại nội dung thiên lệch, độc hại trước fine-tuning.
text.en: Review and curate training examples to remove biased, toxic, or harmful content before fine-tuning.

explanation.vi: Loại ví dụ thiên lệch trước training giảm tín hiệu sai model có thể học.
explanation.en: Removing biased examples before training reduces undesirable learned signals.

text.vi: Ứng dụng phân tích hợp đồng dùng Nova trên Bedrock trong một Region. Mỗi request phải đọc toàn bộ cùng một hợp đồng vì câu hỏi có thể nói đến bất kỳ điều khoản nào. Hàng trăm request mỗi giờ cần giảm chi phí và latency. Chọn cách nào?
text.en: An AI engineer is building a legal document analysis application by using Amazon Bedrock in a single AWS Region. The application uses an Amazon Nova model. Each API call must retrieve a complete legal contract. Partial retrieval is not sufficient because the analytical questions could reference any clause across the entire document. The application will receive hundreds of requests each hour. Each request will reference the same contract. The AI engineer must optimize inference costs and reduce the latency of the application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

text.vi: Bật cross-Region global inference profile.
text.en: Enable the Amazon Bedrock cross-Region inference global profile to distribute requests across multiple Regions.

explanation.vi: Phân phối Region không trực tiếp cache prefix và trái cấu hình một Region được mô tả.
explanation.en: Cross-Region inference distributes requests across Regions for improved availability and throughput. However, cross-Region inference does not reduce costs or latency to process the same document repeatedly. Cross-Region inference does not cache or reuse previously processed content.

text.vi: Bật prompt caching, đặt hợp đồng làm static prefix và thêm cache checkpoint.
text.en: Enable Amazon Bedrock prompt caching. Structure the legal contract as the static prompt prefix. Mark the prompt with a cache checkpoint.

explanation.vi: Prefix lặp đủ điều kiện có thể được tái sử dụng để giảm tính toán/token cost và latency.
explanation.en: Prompt caching provides the ability to reuse previously processed prompts. Prompt caching reduces costs and latency when you use the same content (the legal contract) repeatedly across multiple requests. By structuring the contract as a cached prefix, subsequent requests process only the new analytical questions.

text.vi: Dùng Knowledge Bases retrieve và đưa nội dung hợp đồng vào từng request.
text.en: Store the legal contract in Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases for retrieval. Configure the Amazon Bedrock API to retrieve and inject the contract into each request at runtime.

explanation.vi: Chunk retrieval không bảo đảm đưa toàn bộ hợp đồng theo yêu cầu; không giải quyết tái xử lý prefix như cache.
explanation.en: You can use knowledge bases for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) with partial document retrieval. You would not use knowledge bases to repeatedly process the same complete document. This solution would not optimize costs or reduce latency in this scenario.

text.vi: Dùng batch inference cho mọi câu hỏi trong một job.
text.en: Use Amazon Bedrock batch inference to process all analytical questions against the contract in a single job.

explanation.vi: Batch không phù hợp phản hồi tương tác từng request như ứng dụng này.
explanation.en: Batch inference can process large volumes of requests asynchronously without real-time response requirements. Batch inference does not meet the requirement for real-time responses to hundreds of requests each hour. This solution does not optimize costs for repeated analysis of the same document.

text.vi: Model huấn luyện trên 50.000 ảnh có training error giảm nhanh qua các epoch nhưng tổng quát hóa kém trên evaluation. Phương pháp nào giúp cải thiện?
text.en: A company is training a model on 50,000 images. A first evaluation of the model shows that the training error rapidly decreases as the number of epochs increases, which causes the model to generalize poorly on the evaluation data. An ML engineer must improve the generalization of the model. Which method will meet the requirements?

text.vi: Giảm số ảnh training.
text.en: Decrease the amount of images in the training dataset.

explanation.vi: Giảm dữ liệu thường làm overfitting nặng hơn.
explanation.en: Decreasing the amount of data does not help to prevent overfitting because this method makes the model even more dependent of the training data provided. This method causes the model to generalize poorly when presented to new data that is not part of the initial training dataset.

text.vi: Tăng số feature.
text.en: Increase the amount of features in the training dataset.

explanation.vi: Thêm feature không giải quyết overfitting và có thể tăng độ phức tạp.
explanation.en: Increasing the number of features in the training dataset does not help with overfitting. This method introduces even more noise in the model during training and prevent the model from generalizing properly.

text.vi: Tăng hệ số regularization.
text.en: Increase the number for the regularization hyperparameter.

explanation.vi: Regularization mạnh hơn hạn chế độ phức tạp, có thể giúp tổng quát hóa; cần chọn bằng validation.
explanation.en: An error rate that rapidly decreases as the epochs increases indicates an overfitting problem when training the model. This problem means that the model is memorizing rather than generalizing, and the model is too dependent on the training data. Overfitting causes the model to generalize poorly when presented to new data not present in the initial training dataset. Regularization helps reduce the overfitting of the model because regularization penalizes extreme weight values in model parameters. This method helps the model to generalize better and avoid the initial overfitting issue encountered.

text.vi: Tăng số epoch.
text.en: Increase the number of epochs on the training data.

explanation.vi: Thêm epoch khi đã overfit có thể làm model nhớ train nhiều hơn.
explanation.en: Increasing the number of passes on the existing training data would help improve the accuracy of the model if the issue was that the model did not have enough data to learn from and the model was underfitting. However, because the model is overfitting, increasing the number of passes on the training data makes the model even more dependent of the training data.

text.vi: Endpoint recommender sách dùng target tracking theo số invocations. Spike ngắt quãng gây over-scaling. Cách xử lý ít vận hành nhất?
text.en: A library designed a book recommendation system. The system was deployed by using an Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint. The endpoint has a target tracking scaling policy to auto scale based on the number of invocations metric. After system deployment, traffic has seen intermittent spikes that caused over-scaling. An ML engineer must implement a solution to handle the spike in traffic. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

text.vi: Cấu hình cooldown trong target tracking policy.
text.en: Specify a cooldown period in the target tracking scaling policy.

explanation.vi: Cooldown giúp hạn chế phản ứng scaling liên tiếp; cần chọn scale-in/out phù hợp và đo latency.
explanation.en: You can decrease scaling activities by configuring cooldown periods. This method protects against over-scaling when capacity increases or decreases. The next scaling activity cannot happen until the cooldown period has ended. Therefore, by specifying a cooldown period, you can handle intermittent spikes in traffic.

text.vi: Thay bằng step scaling.
text.en: Replace the target tracking scaling policy with a step scaling policy.

explanation.vi: Đổi policy tạo thêm cấu hình khi cooldown của policy hiện tại có thể đáp ứng.
explanation.en: You can use step scaling policies to increase or decrease the number of instances based on alarm metrics. Step scaling policies are more suitable when you need to scale based on metrics, such as average CPU utilization. However, step scaling does not help you handle spikes in traffic.

text.vi: Tăng target metric scaling.
text.en: Increase the metric value for scaling instances in the target tracking scaling policy.

explanation.vi: Tăng target có thể giảm capacity nhưng không trực tiếp giải quyết phản ứng liên tiếp và có nguy cơ tăng latency.
explanation.en: A target tracking scaling policy targets a metric and automatically adds or removes instances based on the specified target value. To increase the metric does not stop the scaling activities when there is a spike in traffic.

text.vi: Giảm target metric scaling.

explanation.vi: Giảm target thường làm tăng số instance, có thể khiến over-scaling nặng hơn.
